subject: MAP + curated test-suite: proposed sprint & usage lanes
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@retailplus.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: MAP + curated test-suite: proposed sprint & usage lanes

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our call, attached is a lightweight mutual action plan and a first pass at the curated prompt pack + seed testcases we propose to ship for RetailPlus's pilot. High level: 

- Deliverables: Redwood will provide (a) curated prompt pack v1, (b) 2 seed datasets (privacy-scrubbed), (c) a QA testcase subset with acceptance criteria.
- Timeline: sprint kickoff week of Sept 13; delivery of prompt pack + testcases by Sept 24; acceptance window Sept 27–Oct 1; live pilot rollout by Oct 11 if acceptance passes. See MAP_timeline_Sept-Oct2026.pdf attached.
- Usage constraints: datasets and prompt pack are provided for pilot evaluation only. No redistribution or inclusion in public model training. RetailPlus may run internal evals within agreed sandbox. All artifacts are ephemeral and must be destroyed or returned at contract close or at end of pilot window.
- Security & audit: we will provide an evidence package (SOC2 summary, data retention plan, limited audit logs) when you confirm the procurement contact.

Next steps: can you confirm (1) procurement contact for PO/MPA, (2) who on your side will own acceptance tests, and (3) whether the proposed timeline works? Once you confirm, I’ll send the MAP doc (we can do a quick DocuSign for signatures) and provision sandbox API keys for the evaluation.

Attachments referenced: redwood_curated_promptpack_v1.zip, MAP_timeline_Sept-Oct2026.pdf

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com

From: Elena Park <elena@retailplus.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@retailplus.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 11:12:08 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP + curated test-suite: proposed sprint & usage lanes

Jonas — thanks for the clear plan. A few quick clarifications before we loop legal/procurement in: 

1) Retention: our security team will need to understand how long Redwood keeps logs and cached prefixes for the sandbox runs. Can you confirm retention windows and whether logs can be exported on request?

2) Derivative use: we cannot agree to any clause that allows vendor training on our data. We need explicit language that RetailPlus data will not be used for model training or benchmarking outside the pilot without written consent.

3) Escrow/escrow-like holdback: our risk team wants a simple holdback clause for IP associated with the testcases until acceptance completes. Is that something Redwood accepts?

Procurement is CC’d — contact there is procurement@retailplus.com (PO process begins after MPA). Acceptance owner will be myself + QA lead (TBD). The timeline looks tight but doable — Sept 24 delivery for prompt pack is OK if we get materials by Sept 20 at the latest.

Can you also attach the MAP draft and the specific usage covenant language you propose so I can fast-track internal reviews?

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Product, RetailPlus
elena@retailplus.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@retailplus.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 09:18:30 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP + curated test-suite: proposed sprint & usage lanes

Elena — great questions, thanks. Short answers below and attached is a one-page MAP draft (redwood_MAP_draft_v1.docx) with the usage covenant language in plain text.

- Retention: Sandbox request logs and debug traces are retained for 30 days by default. We can provision a short-lived export (JSON) on request during the acceptance window; long-term retention requires a customer-level config (we can set to 0/disabled for your pilot).
- Derivative use: We will include explicit contract language that prohibits Redwood from using RetailPlus data to train models, improve model weights, or include in benchmarking datasets. This is non-negotiable for us to proceed and will be in the MPA we send for signature.
- Holdback: We are open to a limited acceptance holdback mechanism (standard industry phrasing) — 10% of final pilot fee held until final acceptance checklist is signed. Karthik (cc) will help finalize the wording with your legal team.

Next steps: I’ve attached the MAP draft. I can also start the DocuSign flow if you confirm the procurement contact and acceptance owner. Lauren — can you provision a sandbox API key and a short-lived token for RetailPlus once Legal confirms?

Attachments: redwood_MAP_draft_v1.docx

Best,
Jonas
